tools.name: merchant360_check_key
tools.description: Show the merchant the API key acts on, the key's name, its scopes and whether it is live or test. Use it first to confirm the connection. Merchant360 API: GET /me.

tools.name: merchant360_list_staff
tools.description: List the staff roster (name, title, sort order, whether the person has a login). This list is read-only and not paginated. Shift workers use the roster key from merchant360_list_shifts. Merchant360 API: GET /staff.

tools.name: merchant360_list_shifts
tools.description: List team shifts that start in a window, draft and published, earliest first, with the roster of people who can be scheduled (roster[].key is the worker_key to use when writing a shift). Not paginated. The default window starts at Sunday midnight of the current week (server time zone) and lasts 14 d

tools.name: merchant360_get_shift
tools.description: Get one shift by id: worker, start and end, unpaid break, role, note, and whether it is a draft or published. Merchant360 API: GET /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_schedule_requests
tools.description: List staff time-off requests and shift trade requests (drop, pickup, handoff), newest first. Filter by status when set. Not paginated. Old requests are left out by the vendor. Merchant360 API: GET /schedule-requests.

tools.name: merchant360_create_shift
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT shift. Staff do not see it and no text is sent until merchant360_publish_shifts publishes its window. Omit worker_key for an open shift. A shift lasts at most 24 hours. Merchant360 API: POST /shifts.

tools.name: merchant360_update_shift
tools.description: WRITE: change one shift. Fields you omit keep their value. Send worker_key null to make the shift open, and role or note null (or empty) to clear them. A published shift shows the change to staff only after merchant360_publish_shifts runs again. Merchant360 API: PATCH /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_delete_shift
tools.description: WRITE: permanently delete one shift, draft or published. No text is sent. A deleted published shift leaves the staff schedule at the next publish. Merchant360 API: DELETE /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_publish_shifts
tools.description: WRITE: publish every DRAFT shift that starts in the window, so staff can see it. Each worker with a published shift and a mobile number gets a text with a link to their schedule. Publishing an already-published window publishes nothing new. Merchant360 API: POST /shifts/publish.

tools.name: merchant360_decide_schedule_request
tools.description: WRITE: approve or deny one staff time-off or shift trade request. The worker is texted the outcome, with the note when given. Approved time off also blocks those days on the public booking calendar. A decided request returns 409. Merchant360 API: POST /schedule-requests/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_payments
tools.description: List the merchant's card payments, newest first (keyed/online by default; channel card_present lists card-reader sales). Read-only: no tool here charges or refunds. Scope payments:read. Merchant360 API: GET /payments.

tools.name: merchant360_get_payment
tools.description: Get one payment by id (a keyed payment uuid or a card-present tp_ id), with its status and processor result. Scope payments:read. Merchant360 API: GET /payments/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices (not estimates), newest first, optionally by status. Scope invoices:read. Merchant360 API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: merchant360_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice or estimate by id, with its lines, totals, balance and status. Scope invoices:read. Merchant360 API: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates, newest first, optionally by status. Get one with merchant360_get_invoice. Scope estimates:read. Merchant360 API: GET /estimates.

tools.name: merchant360_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, newest first. search matches name, legal name or email (any part), or 3+ digits of the phone. Scope customers:read. Merchant360 API: GET /customers.

tools.name: merchant360_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer. Scope customers:read. Merchant360 API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_catalog
tools.description: List active products and services, sorted by name (price and cost in cents, stock when tracked). Scope inventory:read. Merchant360 API: GET /catalog.

tools.name: merchant360_get_catalog_item
tools.description: Get one catalog item. Scope inventory:read. Merchant360 API: GET /catalog/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List every subscription (recurring billing), including the open bill of invoice subscriptions. Not paginated. Scope recurring:read. Merchant360 API: GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: merchant360_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription with its schedule and open bill. Scope recurring:read. Merchant360 API: GET /subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_plans
tools.description: List up to 200 subscription plans, newest first. Scope recurring:read. Merchant360 API: GET /plans.

tools.name: merchant360_list_appointments
tools.description: List appointments, oldest start first, optionally between two start times. Scope scheduling:read. Merchant360 API: GET /appointments.

tools.name: merchant360_get_appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment. Scope scheduling:read. Merchant360 API: GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_reservations
tools.description: List reservations, newest first, optionally by status. Pass next_cursor from the previous page as cursor. Scope reservations:read. Merchant360 API: GET /reservations.

tools.name: merchant360_get_reservation
tools.description: Get one reservation with its holds, claims and recent events. Scope reservations:read. Merchant360 API: GET /reservations/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_classes
tools.description: List classes, newest first; active true or false filters. Scope scheduling:read. Merchant360 API: GET /classes.

tools.name: merchant360_list_class_sessions
tools.description: List class sessions with seats left, earliest first (includes canceled sessions), optionally for one class and a time window. Scope scheduling:read. Merchant360 API: GET /class-sessions.

tools.name: merchant360_list_session_bookings
tools.description: List every booking on one class session (confirmed, waitlist, canceled). Scope scheduling:read. Merchant360 API: GET /class-sessions/{id}/bookings.

tools.name: merchant360_list_credit_memos
tools.description: List credit memos, newest first. Scope credit_memos:read. Merchant360 API: GET /credit-memos.

tools.name: merchant360_list_statements
tools.description: List the months that have a processing statement, newest first. Scope statements:read. Merchant360 API: GET /statements.

tools.name: merchant360_list_tax_rates
tools.description: List the merchant's tax rates (default first). Use an id as tax.rate_id on an invoice or estimate. Scope tax_rates:read. Merchant360 API: GET /tax-rates.

tools.name: merchant360_list_payment_links
tools.description: List payment links, newest first, including links made for invoices. Scope payment_links:read. Merchant360 API: GET /payment-links.

tools.name: merchant360_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer (name required). Scope customers:write. Merchant360 API: POST /customers.

tools.name: merchant360_update_customer
tools.description: Change the fields you send; fields left out keep their value. null clears legal_name, email or phone. Scope customers:write. Merchant360 API: PATCH /customers/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice in DRAFT status from lines (unit_price in cents), with automatic or chosen tax and an optional discount. It charges nothing. send: true emails it to customer.email and moves it to OPEN with a pay link (the customer pays on the hosted page). Scope invoices:write. Merchant360 API: PO

tools.name: merchant360_create_estimate
tools.description: Create an estimate in DRAFT status from lines (unit_price in cents), with automatic or chosen tax and an optional discount. It charges nothing. send: true emails it to customer.email and moves it to OPEN, where the customer can accept it. Scope estimates:write. Merchant360 API: POST /estimates.

tools.name: merchant360_send_invoice
tools.description: Email an invoice or estimate with its PDF and a pay link for the remaining balance to the customer's email (and text the link when Text2Pay is on). It charges nothing; the customer pays on the hosted page. Scope invoices:write. Merchant360 API: POST /invoices/{id}/send.

tools.name: merchant360_create_catalog_item
tools.description: Create a product or service (price in cents). A SKU is generated from the name when left out. Scope inventory:write. Merchant360 API: POST /catalog.

tools.name: merchant360_update_catalog_item
tools.description: Change name, sku, category, description, price, cost, taxable or track_stock; fields left out keep their value. Stock on hand does not change here. Scope inventory:write. Merchant360 API: PATCH /catalog/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_create_appointment
tools.description: Create an appointment (status scheduled). Merchant360 refuses a time that clashes with the assignee's open appointments. It sends no email or text. Scope scheduling:write. Merchant360 API: POST /appointments.

tools.name: merchant360_update_appointment_status
tools.description: Set an appointment's status (scheduled, confirmed, arrived, in_progress, completed, canceled, no_show). Status is the only field this changes; no email or text is sent. Scope scheduling:write. Merchant360 API: PATCH /appointments/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: merchant360_create_shift, merchant360_list_customers, merchant360_create_invoice, merchant360_create_estimate, merchant360_create_appointment · Private data: merchant360_check_key · Public sink: merchant360_create_shift, merchant360_update_shift, merchant360_delete_shift, merchant360_publish_shifts, merchant360_decide_schedule_request, merchant360_list_customers, merchant360_create_customer, merchant360_update_customer, merchant360_create_invoice, merchant360_create_estimate, merchant360_send_invoice, merchant360_create_catalog_item, merchant360_create_appointment, merchant360_update_appointment_status · Destructive: merchant360_list_schedule_requests, merchant360_delete_shift.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: merchant360_create_shift, merchant360_list_customers, merchant360_create_invoice, merchant360_create_estimate, merchant360_create_appointment · Private data: merchant360_check_key · Public sink: merchant360_create_shift, merchant360_update_shift, merchant360_delete_shift, merchant360_publish_shifts, merchant360_decide_schedule_request, merchant360_list_customers, merchant360_create_customer, merchant360_update_customer, merchant360_create_invoice, merchant360_create_estimate, merchant360_send_invoice, merchant360_create_catalog_item, merchant360_create_appointment, merchant360_update_appointment_status · Destructive: merchant360_list_schedule_requests, merchant360_delete_shift

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
